polishes.description: Love a surprise? Can't decide which Jior lacquers to purchase? This Mystery lacquer grab bag is perfect of you! Looking for certain lacquers or finishes? Leave us a 'NOTE TO SELLER' at checkout. We'll see what we can do! (Please note: there is NO GUARANTEE that you will receive your requested lacquer or finish. It is based on availability.) FINISH: The lacquers may be jellys, crellys, shimmers, glitters, holos, multichromes, glow in the dark, thermals, magnetic, etc and/or combination of these finishes. Part of the fun in receiving mystery lacquers is, you don't know what you migh get. You may be pleasantly surprised to find that 'in the bottle' green polish turns purple once it's applied to warm nails! Or you've got glowing fingers at bedtime! DESCRIPTION: You will receive 2 or 4 different mystery lacquers, depending on the option you select. You will not receive repeats in the same order! These lacquers are prototypes, unreleased, or overstocked lacquers. Past PPU/Collab/Group Exclusive mystery polishes are polishes that were featured in Polish Pickup, polishes made as collaborations, and/or polish made as group exclusives.Regular mystery lacquers will be labeled with numbers instead of names. PPU/Collab/Group Exclusive mystery lacquers will be labeled with the name. **PLEASE NOTE: Occasionally there may be mystery lacquers that may be scented. If you have a sensitivity to scents, please let us know in the 'NOTES' section at checkout. APPLICATION: Apply base coat Apply nail lacquer. Use top coat to seal. INGREDIENTS: Click Here
